fact: WHO's Libya annual report for 2024 states that DHIS2 reached 100% national geographic coverage by March 2023 but that consistent reporting from health facilities remains a challenge, and that WHO and the Ministry of Health began supervisory visits, the first to five health facilities in Suq Aljuma municipality (Tripoli) on 16 to 23 December 2024, assessing the facilities' data entry compliance, reporting timeliness and completeness.
title: Libya annual report, 2024
publisher: WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean
